data.name: Wheel Thrill Climber

alts: Wheel Thrill Climber A-frame climber with hanging rings, rope net and spinning wheels

data.description: Hanging rings, a rope net and a set of spinning wheels all share one A-frame on the Wheel Thrill Climber. Children can climb the net, hang from the rings or turn the wheels, so a small group can play on it at once without waiting for a single route. The spinning wheels add a hands-on element that younger climbers enjoy, while the rings give older children a grip challenge. It takes up 11'1" x 4'7" and needs a safe play area of 16'1" x 9'7". That makes it a practical choice when a school or park wants several climbing activities on a slim footprint. Galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts and play rope are covered by our 3-year warranty. Ask us for a quote and a layout drawing.

props.pText: The A-frame is galvanised pipe and the net is play rope, both covered for 3 years. Moving parts such as bearings carry a 1-year warranty. Installation is self-standing or grouted. Check that the wheels spin freely, look over the rings and rope at each maintenance visit, and keep the 16'1" x 9'7" zone clear.
